resources.string: Notices when you copy text, then reads the clipboard for a moment and sends the text to your computers. With remote paste on, it puts an admin\'s text into the text field that has the focus. It reads nothing else on the screen.
It happens a minute from now; until then, Cancel the reboot or shutdown stops it.
No admin can run them there until its user turns them on again on the device itself.
The quick actions are off there.
Turn off the quick actions on %1$s?
Drag to arrange. Drop a device on a collection to put it in.

Android lets an app read the clipboard only while it is in front. Turn CBB on in Accessibility, and what you copy goes to your computers without a tap; Android then says “CBB pasted from your clipboard” each time. Without it, use the Send clipboard tile, the notification\'s Send button, or Share.

When the phone is not on the home network, it syncs through the WireGuard tunnel of your own hub, a computer of the group set up with cbb global hub; its port is reachable from the internet, but only through WireGuard with the group\'s keys. The hub answers this phone the next time it connects at home. Nothing goes anywhere else, and without the tunnel there is no connection. Turning it off forgets this phone\'s tunnel key.
Connected to the hub through the tunnel.
Connected to the hub %1$s through the tunnel.
Connecting to the hub through the tunnel…
The hub does not answer through the tunnel.
Waiting for the hub: open the app at home once, near a computer of the group.
Everywhere waits while sync is off
This phone is in a group made before 0.6, which this version no longer runs. Leave it on this phone, then make a new group or join one. Nothing is deleted until you leave.
Something in CBB broke. It started again.

Sorry! Allow us to send a short report so that we can fix it? It holds only what broke, the versions of CBB and the system, the device\'s model and CBB\'s own records. Your texts, files, keys, device names and addresses are not in it. The report is anonymous.
The camera is not allowed. Allow it in the app\'s settings to scan, or paste the text of the QR code of cbb pair.
The camera did not start. Paste the text of the QR code of cbb pair instead.
Move the group to this phone
Stays, no longer an admin: make it an admin again later
This cannot be undone. The fingerprint or the screen lock confirms it, and the group\'s devices follow this phone as soon as they connect.
Make this phone the main device
Stays, frozen until you unfreeze it
Scan the code on the group\'s recovery sheet, or type its text. The key stays on this phone only for this change.
The recovery key\'s text, as on the sheet
%1$d of %2$d devices are connected now. The others learn of the change when they connect. An unticked device is removed, and joins again only as a new device.
Write a new change over it
With the group\'s recovery key, this phone becomes the main device, for example when the old one is lost.

A change of the main device is already on its way, and its records have not all arrived. Connect to your devices first; write over it only if that change will never arrive, for example because the phone that made it is lost.
Drag devices here, or add them with Move to collection in a device\'s menu.
The device that makes the group holds its main key: best one that is always with you, such as your phone.
The device did not run the action.
The tiles stay as they were: that change does not fit.
The group\'s admin keys setting does not let this device\'s keys be an admin. Change it in Settings, Admin keys.
Could not read the clipboard, so it was left as it is. Copy the text again, then try again.
This copy was not sealed to this phone, so it cannot be read here. Copy it again on that device.
Error messages show the error underneath them, to find out what failed. Tap the version seven times to see this switch.
This computer keeps its keys in a file. Make it an admin first on its page, which warns what that means.
The group\'s hub did not answer. Check that the invitation is still valid and that the hub is on, then try again.
This image is larger than 100 MB, so it stays on the computer.
Could not get the image from the computers. Copy it there again, then try again.
An admin muted this phone, so its copies stay on it.
NFC is off. Turn it on in the phone\'s settings, then try again.
The computer did not answer. It may be offline, or run an older version of CBB.
Add a fingerprint or face on this phone first: on Android 10 the group\'s keys need one.
Connect this phone to your home Wi-Fi, then try again.
This phone has neither NFC nor a USB port that takes a YubiKey.
CBB was not on the screen, so it could not ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Open CBB and try again.
Set a screen lock on this phone first: the group\'s keys need it.
No device of your group shows six digits on this network. On a phone of the group, tap +, or on a computer choose Add a device, then try again.
Only an admin phone can do this.
The fingerprint, face or screen lock was not confirmed, so nothing changed.
The computer joined but did not confirm it. Check cbb status on it.
This phone is in no group, so there is nothing to leave.
This phone\'s group key was made by an earlier version of the app. Leave the group on this phone and set it up again.
The computer refused. Run cbb pair on it again.
This phone is the group\'s main device, and the group has other devices. Remove them first, or let an admin phone move the group to itself.
This computer is installed without root, so any of its programs can read its keys. It can never be an admin.
No phone scanned the code in five minutes. Try again.
Too many wrong codes. Try again with a new code.
Two devices of your group show six digits at once. Close Add a device on one of them, then try again.
Could not reach the computer. Is it on the same network as this phone, and does its firewall let CBB in?
The code did not match. Run cbb pair on the computer again and scan the new code.
The YubiKey did not answer as expected. Hold it still against the phone and try again.
The YubiKey\'s PIN is blocked. Unblock it with its PUK in Yubico Authenticator, then try again.
This YubiKey holds this group\'s recovery key already.
The app cannot use this YubiKey\'s management key. Use the printed sheet instead.
Every place for keys on this YubiKey is in use. Use another YubiKey or the sheet.
This YubiKey holds no recovery key.
No YubiKey was held to the phone or plugged in.
This YubiKey is older than firmware 5.3, which the recovery key needs. Use the printed sheet instead.
This YubiKey holds two recovery keys for this group. Use the sheet instead.
The phone was not allowed to use the YubiKey on USB. Plug it in again and allow it.
Wrong PIN. After three wrong tries the YubiKey blocks its PIN.
%1$s was frozen: the others refuse it until an admin unfreezes it.
%1$s moved the group to itself: it is the group\'s main device now.
Saved in Downloads, in the folder CBB.
Sent to the computers, which fetch it from this phone now.
For a stolen admin computer: it changes nothing more and the others refuse it until the main device unfreezes or removes it.
The group\'s hub, in use now
Join only if you asked for this invitation. Whoever made it admits this phone once they see the words it shows.
Whoever invited you sees these words on their device and admits this phone if they match. Keep this screen open.
This phone is in a group already. Leave it first to join another.
This phone is in the group. It syncs through the group\'s hub away from home.
This is not a CBB invitation.
This invitation is for another kind of device. Ask for one for this phone.
Point the camera at the invitation\'s QR code.
You are invited to a group
The device joined the group; it appears in the list once it connects.
A device (%1$s) used the invitation. Admit it only if the device shows the same fingerprint:
On a new phone, open CBB, tap Join with an invitation and scan the code. On a computer, run cbb pair -invite with the file. It works once, for an hour, while this app is open; the group needs a hub.
Only an admin makes an invitation: an admin phone here, or cbb invite on an admin computer.
The invitation is open until %1$s. Show or send its QR code only to the person who joins; its file is the fallback.
Six digits or the code\'s text
QR code to join the group
On a phone of the group, tap + and scan the code it shows, or type the six digits under it. Keep both phones on the same network.
On a device of the group, open a pairing window: tap + there. Then type the six digits it shows.
This device has no secure key chip or no strong fingerprint or face sensor: as the group\'s main device it guards the group less well than a phone that has both.
Which devices may be the group\'s admins and hubs. Keys in hardware never leave the device; whoever gets a key in a file can copy it. Admins already in the group stay until you remove them.
This phone\'s own key is not proven, so the group cannot ask for proven keys yet.
Saved. Every device of the group follows it.
This phone types into a TV, a tablet, a console or a computer it is paired with, which needs nothing installed: the clipboard, at your tap, or a remote paste from an admin of the group.
Connecting… The device must be on and near.
No paired devices yet. Make this phone visible, then add it on the device, in its Bluetooth settings.
CBB may not use Bluetooth yet.
Pick the device to type into.
The system did not let this phone be a keyboard. Another app may be the phone\'s keyboard now: turn it off there.
This phone cannot act as a keyboard: its maker left the Bluetooth keyboard profile out of the system.
The device\'s layout has no key for: %1$s. Pick its layout above.
Deletes this phone\'s keys and the group\'s data here; the settings stay.
This phone is the group\'s main device: it leaves only once the group has no other devices.

This phone\'s keys and the group\'s data here are deleted, and remote paste is turned off; the other settings stay. It can then join this group again or another one. The group keeps listing it until an admin removes it.
Make a second phone an admin: on it, tap Join a group, then scan its code here with + and make it an admin.
It is an admin now: it adds and removes devices with cbb pair and cbb remove.

It can then add and remove devices with cbb pair and cbb remove. Its keys sit in a file on the computer: whoever copies that file can act as an admin until another admin removes it. Do this only for a computer you keep safe.
The group then lets keys in files be admins and hubs (Settings, Admin keys).
It can then add and remove devices with cbb pair and cbb remove. Its keys are in its hardware, which never lets them out.
It can then add and remove devices, and move the group to itself if this phone is lost.
Your devices then reach the group through it when they are away from home, through the project\'s forwarder at cbb.tools. Sync away from home must be on there already; only its own user turns it on.
The device is muted: its copies stay its own.
Its copies then reach no device of the group; it still takes theirs.
An admin muted this phone: its copies stay on it until an admin unmutes it.
An admin muted this phone until %1$s: its copies stay on it.
Muted until an admin unmutes it
This is neither a pairing window\'s QR code nor its six digits. On a phone of the group, tap + to show them.
Nothing new to send or fetch.
This phone has a removal to confirm; it does so with your next admin action.
No word from the admin %1$s for a long time: its admin rights end in %2$d days unless it connects.
No word from the admin %1$s for a long time: its admin rights end now.
A change of the group\'s main device is on its way.
The main device\'s records wait for records no device has passed on.
The frozen admin %1$s holds removals back: unfreeze it or remove it.
The group\'s recovery key is not saved yet: without it, losing this phone means making the group again.
Removals wait until every admin has seen them.
%1$s was removed before the main device changed, and counts again now: remove it again if it should not be in the group.
Removals that wait for admins fill %1$s of the main device\'s room for records: bring those admins online.
What they copy comes to this phone. Send sends what this phone copied.
The app notifies of these as soon as it hears of them; the service hears of them in the background too. A paired watch shows them as well.
A device joined or was removed
A device was frozen or unfrozen
The hub does not answer away from home
The group moved to another device
%1$s opened CBB. Syncing may put your computers\' latest copy on this phone\'s clipboard, where that app could read it.
Sync the clipboard with your computers?
Left empty, the phone\'s clipboard goes.
Paste the text of the QR code of cbb pair.

A paste suits most apps; typing suits those that take no paste, and only up to 4 KB. Enter runs a command in a terminal, so the computer takes it only when its user allowed that. A secret leaves no trace in the computer\'s log or clipboard.
It goes where %1$s\'s keyboard focus is, once its user turned remote paste on there.
A picture or files go to the group as a copy, and the computer pastes them where its focus is, as Ctrl+V would: into a chat, a document or a folder. Enter, if on, sends them in a chat.
The group\'s keys for sync away from home have expired: its relay and hubs take no device until this phone renews them with the main device\'s key.
A copy is waiting. Open the app.
A device joined your group. Open the app to see it.
This device\'s record changed. Open the app to check.
A device was removed from your group. Open the app to check.
Your group\'s main device changed. Open the app to check.
Your group stopped. Open the app to check.
A device is waiting to join your group. Open the app.
New in your group. Open the app.
No UnifiedPush distributor is installed. Install one, such as ntfy, to be notified while the app is closed.
A sealed notice goes through your phone\'s push service; only this phone opens it, and neither that service nor CBB\'s sees your copies.
Notifications while the app is closed could not be set up.
A secret was copied. Open the app to see it.
Notify me when the app is closed
%1$s has no quick action turned on. Its user turns them on there, with sudo cbb action enable.
The computer defines what each action does, and runs it only for the admins its user allowed.
Add a computer to your group
Make this phone the group\'s main device
Change which keys may be admins
Renew the group\'s keys for sync away from home
Remove a device from your group
Change how long copies and secrets last
Made with the group, and its sheet was shown once. Without the sheet the group\'s main device cannot change: if the sheet is lost, make a new group.
A sheet to print and keep away from your phones. If the group\'s main phone is lost, another device of the group moves the group to itself with it.
This phone forgets the key now. To get a sheet again, make a new recovery key.
A saved file is the group\'s key: copy it off the phone to paper or a drive kept safe, then delete it here.
To move the group to another device of it: on a phone, choose Move the group to this phone in its settings and scan the code; on a computer, run cbb recovery and type the key.
Keep this sheet somewhere safe, away from your phones. Anyone who has it and a device of the group can move your group to that device.
QR code of the recovery key
Save it on a sheet, on a YubiKey, or both. Only with it can the group move to another main device if this phone is lost. It is shown only now.
Print this sheet or save it as a PDF now. It shows only this once.
Without it, losing this phone means making a new group and joining every device to it again.
Leave without saving the recovery key?
At the relay: no other device of the group is there now.

The clipboard stays encrypted end to end between the devices: the relay cannot read it or pose as a device. It does learn, while the devices use it, which devices of the group are online and their internet addresses, and which of them talk to each other, when and how much they send. A hub of the group\'s own lets none of this out. Use a relay you run yourself, or one whose operator you trust with this.
Give the relay\'s address with its port and its key, as cbb relay prints them, or leave both empty.

For a group without a hub of its own: the devices meet at a relay, such as one set up with cbb relay, while the app syncs. The clipboard stays encrypted between the devices, but the relay learns which of them are online and their addresses, and which talk to each other, when and how much. Leave both fields empty to stop.
The group\'s main device sets the relay for every device; this phone meets the others there while sync away from home is on.
The relay does not take this phone. Check its address and key.
Off: this phone meets nobody at a relay.
Waiting: the relay works while the app syncs.
At the relay; devices of the group there: %1$d.
It will no longer sync with your devices. To add it again, scan its QR code again.
It made the group. This phone moves the group to itself with a new key, and the other devices follow it.
Removed. The other devices refuse it from now on.
The group\'s devices refuse it now. Leave the group to delete its keys here; then it can join a group again.
This phone was removed from the group
Every device of the group shows the new name.
Renamed. The other devices show the new name as soon as they hear of it.
If Android says the setting is restricted: open App info, tap ⋮, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
%1$s is now the group\'s main device, in place of %2$s.
This phone is now the group\'s main device. The other devices hear of it as soon as they connect.
Only the recovery key changes the main device, and nothing undoes it. Leave the group on each of your devices, then make a new group and join them to it.
Someone has the group\'s recovery key
Saved in the gallery, in the album CBB.
None: the phone asks every app.
Share, the selection menu and the cbb send entry let any app hand CBB a text or start a sync, so the phone asks first. “Always for this app” lets that one app go without asking.
%1$s handed CBB a text of %2$d characters. It goes to every computer of the group.
Send this text to your computers?
%1$s handed CBB %2$d items. They go to every computer of the group.
Ctrl+1 to 9 open these sections, Ctrl+N adds a device, the arrows choose a device and Esc closes its details.
Sync is off: nothing goes out or comes in.
One clipboard for this phone and your computers.
How long the latest copy shows as received, for the whole group. A secret also leaves the clipboard when its time is up.
Saved. Every device of the group follows it.
Another admin froze this computer, as one does with a stolen one: it changes nothing and the others refuse it. Unfreeze it only if it is in safe hands; otherwise remove it.
Once a day the app checks for a release the project signed and installs it. The check tells GitHub this device\'s address, as any download does.
The update failed; the app stays as it is.
%1$s needs %2$s installed first: take %2$s from the releases page.

With a key of its own, the watch can freeze an admin computer, remove a device that is no admin, and turn remote paste, quick actions and sync away from home off. It needs a screen lock, and its on-wrist detection should be on.
In this group the watch shows the devices only: its emergency actions come with CBB 0.7.
The watch is an admin now. It can freeze an admin computer, remove a device that is no admin and turn things off.
The watch needs a screen lock. Set one on the watch, keep it on your wrist, then try again.
The watch did not answer. Is it connected to this phone, with CBB installed?
To give a new watch the key, remove this one from the devices first.
On the group\'s main device, decide in its alerts.
Two admins disagree about a device: the group waits for its main device.
Turn on another device of the group.

Turn on Everywhere to sync away from home.
No device of the group is on this network.
Keep this device on near the group\'s other devices until it arrives.
A change of the group\'s main device is on its way.
Turn on the group\'s other devices.
The main device\'s records wait for records no device has passed on.

Update CBB on a computer of the group.

Devices away from home may not reach it; CBB tries again by itself.
The connection server does not take this base.
Ask the group\'s owner to restore its rights.

Check that the base is on and online.
Check that the other devices have Everywhere on.

Unmute it from a trusted device of the group.

If this is your home network, mark it as home.

Make a new group and join your devices to it.

Check the internet connection; CBB tries again by itself.
The backup server does not answer.
Leave the group on this device, then join again.

Move the group to a new main device with the group\'s recovery key.

Let CBB through this computer\'s firewall.

On the new phone, open CBB, tap Join a group and scan this code. A device without a camera, such as a computer, asks for these six digits. Keep this screen open.
Hold the YubiKey to the back of the phone, or plug it into the USB-C port, until this message goes.
Insert your YubiKey or hold it to the phone.
Type the YubiKey\'s PIN, then hold the YubiKey to the phone or plug it into the USB-C port until it is done.

The YubiKey opened the recovery key.
Type the YubiKey\'s PIN, then hold the YubiKey to the phone again.
The recovery key is on the YubiKey. The YubiKey and the sheet hold the same key: keep both, in different places.
Touch the YubiKey when it blinks, and keep it plugged in until this message goes.
Writing to the YubiKey. Keep it plugged in until it is done.
